LanguageData.Rimlink.Colonies.Title: Shared colony
LanguageData.Rimlink.Colonies.Limits: The owner hosts and saves the colony. One partner can control assigned colonists at a time; progress waits while the owner is offline. Membership persists between sessions.
LanguageData.Rimlink.Colonies.Empty: Invite a player to your colony, or refresh to see invitations from other owners.
LanguageData.Rimlink.Colonies.AssignHelp: Allow control of these colonists (up to 32). Changing the assignment ends the current session.
LanguageData.Rimlink.Colonies.RevokeConfirm: End shared access with {0}? Their current cooperation session will end. Colonists remain with the owner.
LanguageData.Rimlink.Colonies.NeedHome: Return to your own colony and finish the current session first.
LanguageData.Rimlink.Colonies.PawnsUnavailable: Assigned colonists are not on this home map. Update the assignment.
LanguageData.Rimlink.Refusal.Colonies.Permission: You do not have permission for this colony, or the invitation was blocked or revoked.
LanguageData.Rimlink.Refusal.Colonies.Invalid: Choose a valid player or assignment. A colony supports eight members and up to 32 assigned colonists.
LanguageData.Rimlink.Refusal.Colonies.NoPawns: The colony owner has not assigned any colonists.
LanguageData.Rimlink.Refusal.Colonies.UpdateClient: Both players must update their mod to use shared colonies.
